mobbin:98032d4a-7cd9-4d93-8993-43d0df586.summary: From the course Curriculum outline the user opens an empty lesson, picks Text & Images from Add content, edits rich text in a focused block editor, then returns to the lesson with the saved TEXT & IMAGES block and Outline sidebar.
steps: Text and images block — blank editor
Text and images block — filled + Save
Lesson with TEXT & IMAGES block + Outline
steal: Lesson row shows content completeness (Empty vs 1 Text & Images) beside Publish/Published (step 1).
Add content drawer categorized CONTENT / EDUCATIONAL TOOLS / … with Quiz next to media blocks (step 2).
Focused block editor with Cancel/Save instead of editing inline on the long lesson page (steps 3–4).
Saved block labeled TEXT & IMAGES with Edit + drag handle; Outline sidebar tracks current lesson (step 5).
avoid: Marketing Tools (Upsell, Referrals) in the same Add content catalog as educational blocks (step 2) — keep scenario building free of commerce chrome.
mobbin:98032d4a-7cd9-4d93-8993-43d0df586.fit: Extends Briefing beyond a single video into block-stacked orientation/pre-brief material; outline + draft Publish mirrors SCE structure without replacing the tabbed Details/Objectives/Patient/Equipment form.

mobbin:8c62da99-7eb3-46dd-9610-d7d932070.summary: From a lesson the user opens Add content, chooses Quiz, builds Question 1 with answers and a correct checkbox, then adds Question 2 one-at-a-time (including an image + alt text) before Save.
steps: Lesson editor — existing blocks + Add content
Quiz block — Q1 answers + Correct answer tooltip
Quiz block — Q1 answers (tooltip still shown)
Quiz block — Q1 correct answer checked
Q2 filled with correct answer checked
Q2 with attached image + alt text
steal: Plan banner when grades won't be recorded (steps 3–4) — clear state that submissions exist without scoring.
Per-answer checkbox for single or multiple correct answers + Add answer (steps 3–4).
Collapsed completed question with checkmark on the keyed answer vs expanded editor (step 5).
Per-question Add image with alt text / Replace (step 7).
avoid: Only + New question one-at-a-time with no bulk/reuse of items (steps 5–7) — checklist authoring for faculty needs shared item banks across scenarios.
mobbin:8c62da99-7eb3-46dd-9610-d7d932070.fit: Maps to learner/faculty checklists (and optional knowledge checks in orientation) more than a pre-brief video; graded quiz chrome should stay lighter than Enterprise Case Manager, but reuse of items is missing vs Essentials' checklist direction.
